newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA 330 FOR FIVE AT TEA V WEST INDIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA 330 FOR FIVE AT TEA V WEST INDIES.

text.p: Australia were 330 for five at tea on the second day of their fourth test match against West Indies at the Adelaide Oval on Sunday.
Australia - 330 for five from 97 overs (Overnight 139 for two) - (Matthew Hayden 125, Mark Waugh 82).
West Indies first innings - 130 in 47.5 overs (Michael Bevan four for 31, Shane Warne three for 42.)
